context: Evaluates correct usage of the warp initiation system including the initiateWarp action, isWarping state, and WARP_CONFIG.COOLDOWN enforcement. Tests that warp cannot be triggered while already active, and that the button correctly reflects warp state.

checklist.name: initiateWarp Call
checklist.description: initiateWarp() from useWormholeActions is called when the boost button is clicked and the conditions allow it

checklist.name: isWarping Guard
checklist.description: useWormholeState().isWarping is checked before calling initiateWarp; the action is not invoked when isWarping is true

checklist.name: Cooldown Awareness
checklist.description: The component either relies on the internal WARP_CONFIG.COOLDOWN enforcement in initiateWarp, or explicitly tracks time since last warp using WARP_CONFIG.COOLDOWN (2000ms)

checklist.name: Button Disabled State
checklist.description: The button is visually disabled (disabled attribute or pointer-events:none) while isWarping is true

checklist.name: Warp State Label
checklist.description: Button label changes to reflect active warp (e.g., 'WARPING...' vs 'BOOST') based on isWarping or warpPhase from useWormholeState
